name: Career Engine Daily Scan
prompt: This scheduled Career Engine run is explicitly owner-authorized for direct autonomous execution. Do not create Kanban, delegate merely because it is multi-step, or stop after describing a plan. Execute the pipeline with tools until completion or a genuine blocking error. Authority order: 1 Vault master projects/agent-ops/model-routing.md for inference, 2 career-engine.v1.json, 3 runtime bundle, 4 central rules, 5 Vault Career Engine contract/truth, 6 owner/dashboard, 7 review diff lessons. Run doctor+bundle status. Use bundle threshold. Invoke the repository-owned source CLI and configured source registry explicitly, including LinkedIn-public and Freehire discovery, then scan and score all discovered jobs and run the canonical no-send pipeline for all eligible jobs. Enforce discipline/function fit before title similarity: software/IT engineering, rail-specialist delivery, pure business-development/sales and contract-administration roles must not be promoted merely because their titles contain Manager, Engineering, Project, Construction or Lead. After run/reconcile, complete the manual-generation loop for every eligible non-submitted pending generation in the same daily run: read/export each request, use only current canonical Vault career evidence plus the full job description and runtime bundle, produce factual structured output with claim citations, import via ./career-engine generate import, validate, render both required variants as applicable, package the selected route, and create only a verified UNSENT Gmail draft for a verified email route. The configured packet cap is a bounded initial batch size, not permission to defer a qualified backlog to later days; continue the existing request/import loop until no eligible pending generation remains or each remaining item has a genuine evidence/validation blocker. Re-run/sync as needed. Before the final report, query the full canonical CareerTracker, not only jobs newly discovered today, and surface a Top Actionable Jobs section with the best 10 currently non-applied roles at or above the high-priority threshold. Exclude applied/submitted/sent, rejected, superseded, explicitly closed and blocked roles; rank primarily by fit score and current role relevance, and include already-tracked roles when they are better than today's new records. The daily report must answer which jobs the owner should apply to now, not merely which rows changed today. Never fabricate evidence, send/contact/submit, or mark applied. Prepare verified unsent email drafts or portal packages, sync tracker/dashboard, publish the privacy-safe daily review projection, and inspect authorized alerts. Never send/contact/submit.
